questions.text: Under the 'increasing cover' feature of the Promise2Secure life insurance plan launched by Canara HSBC Life Insurance, what is the maximum percentage up to which the sum assured can grow relative to the original amount?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 100%

In News

  • Canara HSBC Life Insurance has announced the launch of Promise2Secure, a comprehensive non-linked, non-participating individual pure risk premium life insurance plan.

Key Points

  • Increasing Cover Feature: Under this feature, the sum assured grows by 10% annually. This growth continues until it reaches 100% of the original sum assured over a ten-year period. This is designed to help policyholders keep pace with inflation.
  • Block Your Premium: The plan also offers a Block Your Premium rate feature, which allows customers to increase the sum assured by up to 100% within the first five years.
  • Plan Variants: The product is available in two options: Life Secure and Life Secure with Return of Premium.
  • The other options (50%, 75%, and 200%) do not align with the specific growth cap defined in the product features.

Additional Information

  • Canara HSBC Life Insurance was incorporated in 2007 and is a joint venture between Canara Bank (36.5%) and HSBC Insurance (Asia Pacific) Holdings Limited (25.5%).
  • The company is headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana.
  • The plan includes coverage for 40 specified critical illnesses and provides a waiver of future premiums upon the diagnosis of a terminal illness.

Important Points

  • Premium Deferment: The plan offers a facility to defer premiums for up to 12 months without impacting the risk cover.
  • Insta Payout: It features an Insta payout feature for eligible death claims to provide immediate financial support.
  • Value Added Services: Includes online will preparation for legacy planning and a health and wellness ecosystem.

questions.text: With the inscription of the Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath in July 2026, what is the total number of UNESCO World Heritage Sites now located in India?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 45

In News

  • The Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath in Uttar Pradesh was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List on 25 July 2026.

Key Points

  • With the inclusion of Sarnath, India now has a total of 45 World Heritage sites.
  • The decision was announced during the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee held in Busan, Republic of Korea.
  • Sarnath is historically significant as the place where the Buddha delivered his first sermon in the sixth century BCE.
  • The property includes major archaeological remains such as the Chaukhandi Stupa, Dhamek Stupa, and Dharmarajika Stupa.
  • Hence, the correct number of sites in India after this update is 45.

Additional Information

  • The World Heritage List currently includes 1,248 properties across 170 countries globally.
  • The site of Sarnath is also referred to in sacred texts by names such as Rishipatana, Isipatana, and Mrigadava (Deer Park).
  • The World Heritage Committee is responsible for implementing the 1972 World Heritage Convention.

Important Points

  • India's 45th Site: Sarnath.
  • Session: 48th session of the World Heritage Committee.
  • Location of Announcement: Busan, Republic of Korea.
  • Historical Context: Marks the beginning of the spread of Buddhist teachings.

questions.text: Where is India's first bank-led Quantum Finance Hub being established following the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Andhra Pradesh and Punjab National Bank (PNB)?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Amaravati

In News

  • The Government of Andhra Pradesh and Punjab National Bank (PNB) signed a landmark MoU to establish the PNB Quantum Finance Hub at Amaravati Quantum Valley (AQV).

Key Points

  • The MoU marks the launch of India's first bank-led Quantum Finance Hub.
  • The agreement was exchanged in the presence of Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu and PNB Managing Director and CEO Ashok Chandra.
  • The Hub is situated at Amaravati Quantum Valley (AQV) in Amaravati, reflecting the state's vision to become a global center for deep technologies.
  • The collaborative platform will bring together industry, academia, startups, and research institutions to develop practical solutions for cybersecurity, fraud detection, and digital financial systems.
  • Other options like Visakhapatnam, Hyderabad, and Vijayawada are incorrect as the news explicitly identifies Amaravati as the location for this hub.

Additional Information

  • Punjab National Bank is the first bank in India to partner with a state government for such a dedicated Quantum Finance Hub.
  • The hub aims to harness Quantum Computing and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to reshape the financial landscape and improve risk management.
  • It focuses on building a skilled workforce capable of driving digital transformation in the banking sector.

Important Points

  • The establishment of this hub is a milestone in Amaravati's development as an innovation ecosystem for deep technologies.
  • Key focus areas include next-generation technologies, optimising business operations, and enhancing customer experience in banking.

questions.text: Which organization collaborated with the Office of the Chief Controller of Accounts (CCA) to develop the AI-enabled Rural Internal Audit Portal launched in June 2026?

options.text: Office of the Controller General of Accounts (CGA)

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is National Informatics Centre (NIC)

In News

  • Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched an artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled Rural Internal Audit Portal on June 28, 2026, to strengthen financial oversight.

Key Points

  • The Rural Internal Audit Portal was conceived by the Office of the Chief Controller of Accounts (CCA) and developed in collaboration with the National Informatics Centre (NIC).
  • It is a unified digital platform designed for the end-to-end management of internal audits, replacing manual and paper-based processes.
  • The portal covers both risk-based and compliance audits, integrating planning, execution, reporting, and monitoring into one ecosystem.
  • The use of AI and machine learning tools within the portal facilitates risk assessment, audit prioritization, and decision support.

Additional Information

  • The Office of the Controller General of Accounts (CGA), Ministry of Finance, has granted in-principle approval for the portal to be adopted across all civil ministries and departments.
  • The platform features interactive dashboards for real-time monitoring of Action Taken Reports (ATRs) and financial irregularities.
  • It aims to enhance transparency and accountability in government spending through data-driven management systems.

Important Points

  • The portal is the first-of-its-kind unified digital platform for comprehensive internal audit management in the government sector.
  • AI-powered capabilities support predictive analytics and pattern recognition for identifying high-risk entities.
  • Future upgrades are expected to include deeper AI integration and advanced risk-scoring mechanisms.

questions.text: Which global fashion sourcing platform signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) with the Bharat Tex Trade Federation (BTTF) during the inauguration of Bharat Tex 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Première Vision Paris

In News

  • Union Minister of Textiles, Shri Giriraj Singh, inaugurated Bharat Tex 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, which included the signing of a strategic partnership agreement.

Key Points

  • During the inaugural ceremony of Bharat Tex 2026, a Letter of Intent (LoI) was exchanged between the Bharat Tex Trade Federation (BTTF) and Première Vision Paris.
  • Première Vision Paris is recognized as one of the world's foremost textile and fashion sourcing platforms.
  • The LoI was signed by Ms. Florence Rousson (CEO, Fashion Division, Première Vision SA) and Shri Naren Goenka (Chairman, BTTF) in the presence of the Union Minister.
  • The partnership focuses on deepening India-Europe collaboration in innovation, sustainability, design excellence, and global market access.
  • The agreement establishes a framework for exhibition partnerships, joint export promotion, and a Joint Steering Committee to guide implementation.
  • Other options like Milan Unica, Texworld, and Intertextile Shanghai are international textile platforms but were not the ones that signed this specific LoI at Bharat Tex 2026.

Additional Information

  • Bharat Tex 2026 featured over 6,000 buyers from more than 130 countries and 1.3 lakh trade visitors.
  • The event spanned more than 1.6 million sq. ft. of exhibition space, showcasing over 20,000 textile products.
  • Eight Sponsor States participated: Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu.
  • International delegations from countries including Russia, New Zealand, USA, and Japan attended the event to reinforce global trade dialogues.

Important Points

  • The event aligns with the Prime Minister's 5F Vision: Farm to Fibre to Factory to Fashion to Foreign.
  • The CITI Textile Sustainability Awards 2026 were also hosted during the event to recognize responsible business practices.
  • The platform facilitated over 4,000 B2B meetings and the signing of more than 30 MoUs across the textile value chain.

questions.text: Through which legislative amendment was the Improvement Notice mechanism introduced under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009, to promote Ease of Doing Business?

options.text: Ease of Doing Business (Statutory Returns) Act, 2023

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026

In News

  • The Department of Consumer Affairs has introduced the Improvement Notice mechanism under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009, as a reform to promote trust-based governance.

Key Points

  • Legislative Basis: The Improvement Notice mechanism was introduced through the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026, which modifies the implementation of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
  • Mechanism Purpose: It allows businesses (manufacturers, importers, packers, etc.) to correct specified first-time procedural or regulatory non-compliances within a reasonable time before any penal proceedings are initiated.
  • Enforcement: If the entity fails to comply with the Improvement Notice within the prescribed period, or in cases of repeated violations or tampering, action under the original provisions of the Legal Metrology Act will continue.
  • Impact: The reform aims to reduce unnecessary litigation and compliance costs while maintaining strong consumer protection standards.

Additional Information

  • The mechanism covers several sections of the Legal Metrology Act, including Section 31 (Non-production of documents), Section 32 (Failure to obtain model approval), and Section 45 (Manufacture of weights and measures without registration).
  • It applies to MSMEs, traders, and various regulated entities to support honest businesses in achieving compliance without the immediate threat of penalties.

Important Points

  • Date of Introduction: The reform was officially posted by the PIB Delhi on 29 June 2026.
  • Governance Philosophy: It aligns with the government's vision of "Minimum Government, Maximum Governance" by shifting towards a facilitative regulatory framework.

questions.text: According to the International Monetary Fund’s (IMF) July 2026 World Economic Outlook (WEO) Update, what is the projected GDP growth rate for India in FY2026-27?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 6.4 per cent

In News

  • The International Monetary Fund (IMF) released its July 2026 World Economic Outlook (WEO) Update, providing revised growth projections for the global economy and individual nations.

Key Points

  • India's Projection: The IMF has projected that India's GDP will expand by 6.4 per cent in FY2026-27.
  • Growth Drivers: This growth is expected to be supported by strong private consumption and robust services sector activity.
  • Global Context: India continues to be one of the fastest-growing major economies, outperforming others despite global trade disruptions.
  • Comparison with other options:
    • 3.4 per cent: This is the projected global economic growth for 2027.
    • 4.6 per cent: This is the projected growth for China in 2026.
    • 7.5 per cent: This is the upwardly revised growth forecast for Vietnam.

Additional Information

  • Global Growth: Projected to slow to 3.0 per cent in 2026 before recovering slightly in 2027.
  • World Trade Volume: Expected to decelerate to 3.5 per cent in 2026 from 5.0 per cent in 2025.
  • Inflation: Global headline inflation is projected to rise to 4.7 per cent in 2026, driven by energy and food prices, before easing to 3.9 per cent in 2027.
  • Other Economies (2026): The United States is projected at 2.3 per cent, the United Kingdom at 1.0 per cent, and Japan at 0.6 per cent.

Important Points

  • The IMF highlights that while India remains a bright spot, global growth is facing headwinds from trade disruptions, geopolitical uncertainties, and higher tariffs.
  • Inflation targets in major economies like the US and UK are expected to be achieved only by mid-to-late 2027.

questions.text: According to the news report, where did the center of Typhoon Maysak make landfall in Vietnam in July 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Mong Cai

In News

  • Typhoon Maysak, the first storm of 2026 in the East Sea, weakened into a tropical depression after moving inland over China’s Guangxi Province following its landfall in Vietnam.

Key Points

  • The storm's center approached the Quang Ninh coastline and remained nearly stationary for over two hours before making landfall near Mong Cai at approximately 10 p.m.
  • Mong Cai recorded significant wind speeds of 88 kph with gusts reaching up to 133 kph and received nearly 250 mm of rain in less than 24 hours.
  • Hoang Sa Special Zone (Paracel Islands) was the area northwest of which the storm originally developed from a tropical depression.
  • Bach Long Vi Island and Co To Island recorded strong winds and gusts but were not the locations of the primary landfall.
  • By 2 a.m. on Sunday, the storm had crossed into southern Guangxi Province, China, where it eventually weakened into a tropical depression by midday Sunday.

Additional Information

  • Preliminary reports from Quang Ninh authorities indicated that the storm damaged 600 hectares of aquaculture farms and toppled 850 trees.
  • The storm also tore roofs off 30 houses and caused damage to various public works and vehicles.
  • Maysak was characterized by its slow movement, which prolonged its impact and allowed heavy rain and strong winds to persist across northeastern Vietnam.

Important Points

  • Vietnam's 2026 rainy and typhoon season is forecast to have fewer storms and tropical depressions than the long-term average and fewer than in 2025.
  • Meteorological authorities warned that climate change makes storm tracks and intensity highly unpredictable.

questions.text: Under the new funding agreement with Bukhman Philanthropies, what is the revised total prize money for the winner of the newly renamed Bukhman International Booker Prize?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 100,000 Pounds

In News

  • The International Booker Prize is being renamed the Bukhman International Booker Prize following a funding commitment for the next decade from Bukhman Philanthropies.

Key Points

  • As part of the agreement with Bukhman Philanthropies, the winner's prize money has doubled from 50,000 Pounds to 100,000 Pounds (approximately Rs 1.28 crore).
  • The prize money is designed to be shared equally between the author and the translator(s), highlighting the collaborative effort in translated literature.
  • Every shortlisted title will also receive 5,000 Pounds (Rs 6.4 lakh), which is also split evenly between the author and translator.
  • The first winner under this new title and increased prize amount will be announced in May 2027.

Additional Information

  • Bukhman Philanthropies was founded by Dmitry Bukhman, co-founder of the mobile gaming company Playrix, and his wife Daria Bukhman.
  • Dmitry Bukhman was ranked among the UK's ten richest people under 40 in 2025.
  • The 2027 judging panel will be chaired by novelist Katie Kitamura, and includes members like Caleb Azumah Nelson and Tessa Thompson.

Important Points

  • The 2026 International Booker Prize was won by Taiwan Travelogue, which was translated from Mandarin by Lin King.
  • The prize focuses on fiction translated into English and published in the UK or Ireland.

questions.text: Which organization has been engaged as the Development Cum Production Partner (DcPP) for Mission Systems under the Airborne Early Warning & Control (AEW&C) MK-II programme?

options.text: Directorate General of Aeronautical Quality Assurance

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Adani Defence Systems and Technologies (ADSTL)

In News

  • On July 22, 2026, the Centre for Air Borne Systems (CABS), under DRDO, signed two major contracts with industry partners to boost the AEW&C MK-II programme as part of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative.

Key Points

  • Adani Defence Systems and Technologies (ADSTL): A contract was signed with ADSTL, Ahmedabad, to act as the Development Cum Production Partner (DcPP) for the Mission Systems specifically designed for the AEW&C MKII Programme.
  • AI Engineering Services Limited (AIESL): This New Delhi-based entity signed a contract for the conversion of six A321 Aircraft from commercial to green configuration.
  • Integration Role: CABS, DRDO, with support from ADSTL, is responsible for integrating these mission systems onto the modified AEW&C MK II Platform, which is delivered by the Original Equipment Manufacturer, Airbus Defence & Space.
  • Certification: The CABS and ADSTL will perform flight testing alongside the Indian Air Force to obtain airworthiness certification from CEMILAC and DGAQA.

Additional Information

  • The AEW&C MK II System is designed to provide enhanced endurance, advanced airborne surveillance, and secure communication.
  • It aims to improve situational awareness and provide enhanced command and control capabilities for air defence.
  • The signing ceremony took place in New Delhi in the presence of Defence Secretary and Chairman DRDO, Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh.

Important Points

  • The programme involves the modification of six A321 Aircraft for military usage.
  • The collaboration reaffirms the government's commitment to self-reliance and fostering a robust ecosystem for defence manufacturing within India.

questions.text: In which city was the International Centre for Civilizational Studies "Manas and Mahabharata" inaugurated in July 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Bishkek

In News

  • An Indian delegation visited Kyrgyzstan from July 4 to 7, 2026, to participate in the inauguration of the International Centre for Civilizational Studies "Manas and Mahabharata".

Key Points

  • The centre was established by the Manas National Academy (Kyrgyzstan) in collaboration with the Centre for Studies of International Relations (CSIR), New Delhi.
  • The inauguration took place in Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan, during a visit where the Indian delegation held high-level bilateral meetings with Kyrgyz officials like Oktyabr Kapalbayev.
  • During the event, trilateral cooperation agreements were signed between the Manas National Academy, the CSIR, and seven universities in Kyrgyzstan, such as KNU and AUCA.
  • Sunil Ambekar, a member of the National Executive Committee of the RSS, served as the chief guest at the ceremony.

Additional Information

  • The event featured the release of the first Hindi translation of the Kyrgyz epic Manas, translated by Professor Hem Chandra Pande and Professor Ramakant Dwivedi.
  • The translation is based on a Russian poetic retelling by Mar Baizhiev and covers all three parts of the epic: Manas, Semetey, and Seitek.
  • The Indian delegation included scholars such as Dr. Punit Gaur and was supported by the Indian Embassy in Kyrgyzstan.

Important Points

  • The establishment of this centre is a historic initiative that aligns with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's proposal to establish a Civilizational Dialogue Forum.
  • The centre aims to foster humanitarian diplomacy, international scientific cooperation, and training for researchers in epic traditions and intercultural dialogue.

questions.text: Mannathu Padmanabhan, whose statue was recently unveiled by Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan in New Delhi, was the founder of which organization?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Nair Service Society (NSS)

In News

  • Vice President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan unveiled the statue of social reformer and freedom fighter Mannathu Padmanabhan and inaugurated the Mannam Smrithi Mandapam in New Delhi on July 12, 2026.

Key Points

  • Mannathu Padmanabhan was a distinguished social reformer and freedom fighter who dedicated his life to society's upliftment through education, social reform, and self-reliance.
  • He was the founder of the Nair Service Society (NSS), an organization dedicated to community service and social progress.
  • The statue and the Mannam Smrithi Mandapam were established at the Mannam International Centre in Dwarka, New Delhi, by NSS Delhi.
  • The Vice President highlighted that Padmanabhan believed great institutions are built by great commitment rather than just wealth, citing his use of humble contributions to build educational institutions.

Additional Information

  • NSS Delhi has expanded to 25 branches across the Delhi-NCR region and boasts nearly 25,000 members.
  • The organization is also involved in preserving Kerala’s cultural heritage, including traditional arts like Kalaripayattu, Kathakali, and Mohiniyattam.
  • During the event, a sapling was planted as part of the nationwide ‘Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam’ campaign for environmental conservation, organized by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

Important Points

  • The Mannam Smrithi Mandapam is described as a memorial that serves as a living tribute to a visionary whose ideals of social justice and equality transcend caste and region.
  • The unveiling ceremony was attended by several dignitaries, including Union Minister of State Shri Suresh Gopi and NSS Delhi President Shri M. K. G. Pillai.

questions.text: Under the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana, what is the mandatory amount to be deposited into a recurring deposit (RD) account from the total monthly financial assistance?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is ₹1,500

In News

  • The Delhi government has approved the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana, a new initiative aimed at providing monthly financial assistance to eligible women in the capital.

Key Points

  • The scheme provides a total monthly assistance of ₹2,500 to eligible women.
  • Out of this amount, ₹1,500 is mandatorily deposited into a recurring deposit (RD) account, while the remaining ₹1,000 can be withdrawn by the beneficiary.
  • The recurring deposit has a three-year lock-in period, after which the accumulated amount and interest are credited to the beneficiary's bank account.
  • The initiative aims to help women build a financial cushion and ensure long-term financial stability for families.

Additional Information

  • Eligibility: Women aged between 21 and 60 years are eligible. Only one woman per household (the eldest if multiple qualify) can apply.
  • Income Criteria: The combined family income must be less than ₹2.5 lakh per annum.
  • Exclusions: Government employees, income tax payers, pensioners, and owners of four-wheelers are not eligible for the scheme.
  • Verification: Applicants must have been residents of Delhi for at least 10 years and have no criminal records in the family.

Important Points

  • The portal for the scheme is scheduled to be launched on August 1.
  • Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta stated that the government intends to release the first instalment by Raksha Bandhan.
  • Required documents include Aadhaar cards, voter identity cards, and a 10-year residency self-declaration.

questions.text: In July 2026, which of the following sites was inscribed as the first-ever addition to the UNESCO World Heritage List from South Sudan?

options.text: Ancient capitals of Asuka and Fujiwara

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Boma-Badingilo Migratory Landscape

In News

  • In July 2026, a UNESCO committee meeting held in Busan, South Korea, added several new sites to the World Heritage List, including the first-ever site from South Sudan.

Key Points

  • Boma-Badingilo Migratory Landscape: This site was inscribed as South Sudan's first addition to the World Heritage List. It is home to one of the world's largest land mammal migrations, featuring white-eared kob, tiang, and Mongalla gazelles. Hence, Option 2 is correct.
  • Asuka and Fujiwara: These represent ancient Japanese capitals in the Nara prefecture, dating from the 6th to 8th century, and were also added to the list during the same meeting. Hence, Option 1 is incorrect.
  • D-Day landing beaches: Located in Normandy, France, these sites (Omaha, Utah, Sword, Gold, and Juno) were added to recognize their role in World War II. Hence, Option 3 is incorrect.
  • Mount Olympus: Greece's tallest mountain and the mythical home of the 12 Olympian gods was rewarded with a mixed cultural and natural heritage status. Hence, Option 4 is incorrect.

Additional Information

  • The Boma-Badingilo site encompasses wetlands, flood plains, and savannas, providing habitat for elephants, lions, and cheetahs.
  • An estimated 6 million animals move across the South Sudanese landscape in response to changing environmental conditions.
  • The ICOMOS (International Council on Monuments and Sites) evaluates submissions for the heritage committee regarding cultural importance.

Important Points

  • The D-Day beaches designation includes Pointe du Hoc, where Allied troops landed on June 6, 1944.
  • Mount Olympus rises 2,918 metres and was inscribed after a 12-year effort by Greece.
  • The Japanese sites of Asuka and Fujiwara reflect a centralized state model inspired by Chinese systems.

questions.text: Which two Indian cities are currently being considered as potential host cities for the 2029 World Abilitysport Games following the MoU signed between the PCI and CPSFI?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Chennai and Bhubaneshwar

In News

  • The Paralympic Committee of India (PCI) and the Cerebral Palsy Sports Federation of India (CPSFI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to jointly bid for the 2029 World Abilitysport Games.

Key Points

  • As part of the bid process, Chennai and Bhubaneshwar are currently being considered as the potential host cities for the event.
  • Discussions will be held with the respective State Governments to assess sporting infrastructure, accessibility, accommodation, and transport before a final recommendation is made to World Abilitysport.
  • The proposed 2029 Games are expected to attract over 1,500 athletes, officials, and support personnel from across the globe.
  • The games will feature disciplines such as Para Athletics, Para Swimming, Para Badminton, Para Fencing, CP Football, Para Table Tennis, and Para Wheelchair Basketball (3-a-side).

Additional Information

  • India previously hosted the IWAS World Games in Bengaluru in the year 2009.
  • The current President of the Paralympic Committee of India (PCI) is Devendra Jhajharia.
  • The President of the Cerebral Palsy Sports Federation of India (CPSFI) is Rajesh Tomar.
  • The initiative aims to create a lasting legacy for Para sport in India through enhanced capacity building and sports tourism.

Important Points

  • The partnership between PCI and CPSFI is a strategic move to strengthen India's position in the global Paralympic movement.
  • The 2029 bid represents an opportunity to welcome the international Para sport community to India after a gap of two decades.
